en.text: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

zhSimplified.text: 信就是所望之事的实底，是未见之事的确据。

zhTraditional.text: 信就是所望之事的實底，是未見之事的確據。

en.text: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

zhSimplified.text: 古人在这信上得了美好的证据。

zhTraditional.text: 古人在這信上得了美好的證據。

en.text: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

zhSimplified.text: 我们因着信，就知道诸世界是借 神的话造成的；这样，所看见的，并不是从显然之物造出来的。

zhTraditional.text: 我們因着信，就知道諸世界是藉上帝話造成的；這樣，所看見的，並不是從顯然之物造出來的。

en.text: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯因着信，献祭与 神，比该隐所献的更美，因此便得了称义的见证，就是 神指他礼物作的见证。他虽然死了，却因这信，仍旧说话。

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯因着信，獻祭與上帝，比該隱所獻的更美，因此便得了稱義的見證，就是上帝指他禮物作的見證。他雖然死了，卻因這信，仍舊說話。

en.text: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

zhSimplified.text: 以诺因着信，被接去，不至于见死，人也找不着他，因为 神已经把他接去了；只是他被接去以先，已经得了 神喜悦他的明证。

zhTraditional.text: 以諾因着信，被接去，不至於見死，人也找不着他，因為上帝已經把他接去了；只是他被接去以先，已經得了上帝喜悅他的明證。

en.text: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

zhSimplified.text: 人非有信，就不能得 神的喜悦；因为到 神面前来的人必须信有 神，且信他赏赐那寻求他的人。

zhTraditional.text: 人非有信，就不能得上帝的喜悅；因為到上帝面前來的人必須信有上帝，且信他賞賜那尋求他的人。

en.text: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

zhSimplified.text: 挪亚因着信，既蒙 神指示他未见的事，动了敬畏的心，预备了一只方舟，使他全家得救。因此就定了那世代的罪，自己也承受了那从信而来的义。

zhTraditional.text: 挪亞因着信，既蒙上帝指示他未見的事，動了敬畏的心，預備了一隻方舟，使他全家得救。因此就定了那世代的罪，自己也承受了那從信而來的義。

en.text: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯拉罕因着信，蒙召的时候就遵命出去，往将来要得为业的地方去；出去的时候，还不知往哪里去。

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯拉罕因着信，蒙召的時候就遵命出去，往將來要得為業的地方去；出去的時候，還不知往哪裏去。

en.text: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

zhSimplified.text: 他因着信，就在所应许之地作客，好像在异地居住帐棚，与那同蒙一个应许的以撒、雅各一样。

zhTraditional.text: 他因着信，就在所應許之地作客，好像在異地居住帳棚，與那同蒙一個應許的以撒、雅各一樣。

en.text: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

zhSimplified.text: 因为他等候那座有根基的城，就是 神所经营所建造的。

zhTraditional.text: 因為他等候那座有根基的城，就是上帝所經營所建造的。

en.text: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

zhSimplified.text: 因着信，连撒拉自己，虽然过了生育的岁数，还能怀孕，因她以为那应许她的是可信的。

zhTraditional.text: 因着信，連撒拉自己，雖然過了生育的歲數，還能懷孕，因她以為那應許她的是可信的。

en.text: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

zhSimplified.text: 所以从一个仿佛已死的人就生出子孙，如同天上的星那样众多，海边的沙那样无数。

zhTraditional.text: 所以從一個彷彿已死的人就生出子孫，如同天上的星那樣眾多，海邊的沙那樣無數。

en.text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 这些人都是存着信心死的，并没有得着所应许的；却从远处望见，且欢喜迎接，又承认自己在世上是客旅，是寄居的。

zhTraditional.text: 這些人都是存着信心死的，並沒有得着所應許的；卻從遠處望見，且歡喜迎接，又承認自己在世上是客旅，是寄居的。

en.text: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

zhSimplified.text: 说这样话的人是表明自己要找一个家乡。

zhTraditional.text: 說這樣話的人是表明自己要找一個家鄉。

en.text: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

zhSimplified.text: 他们若想念所离开的家乡，还有可以回去的机会。

zhTraditional.text: 他們若想念所離開的家鄉，還有可以回去的機會。

en.text: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

zhSimplified.text: 他们却羡慕一个更美的家乡，就是在天上的。所以 神被称为他们的 神，并不以为耻，因为他已经给他们预备了一座城。

zhTraditional.text: 他們卻羨慕一個更美的家鄉，就是在天上的。所以上帝被稱為他們的上帝，並不以為恥，因為他已經給他們預備了一座城。

en.text: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only bornson,

footnotes.text: 11:17 The phrase “only born” is from the Greek word “μονογενη”, which is sometimes translated “only begotten” or “one and only”.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伯拉罕因着信，被试验的时候，就把以撒献上；这便是那欢喜领受应许的，将自己独生的儿子献上。

zhTraditional.text: 亞伯拉罕因着信，被試驗的時候，就把以撒獻上；這便是那歡喜領受應許的，將自己獨生的兒子獻上。

en.text: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

zhSimplified.text: 论到这儿子，曾有话说：「从以撒生的才要称为你的后裔。」

zhTraditional.text: 論到這兒子，曾有話說：「從以撒生的才要稱為你的後裔。」

en.text: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 他以为 神还能叫人从死里复活；他也仿佛从死中得回他的儿子来。

zhTraditional.text: 他以為上帝還能叫人從死裏復活；他也彷彿從死中得回他的兒子來。

en.text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

zhSimplified.text: 以撒因着信，就指着将来的事给雅各、以扫祝福。

zhTraditional.text: 以撒因着信，就指着將來的事給雅各、以掃祝福。

en.text: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

zhSimplified.text: 雅各因着信，临死的时候，给约瑟的两个儿子各自祝福，扶着杖头敬拜 神。

zhTraditional.text: 雅各因着信，臨死的時候，給約瑟的兩個兒子各自祝福，扶着杖頭敬拜上帝。

en.text: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

zhSimplified.text: 约瑟因着信，临终的时候，提到以色列族将来要出埃及，并为自己的骸骨留下遗命。

zhTraditional.text: 約瑟因着信，臨終的時候，提到以色列族將來要出埃及，並為自己的骸骨留下遺命。

en.text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

zhSimplified.text: 摩西生下来，他的父母见他是个俊美的孩子，就因着信，把他藏了三个月，并不怕王命。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西生下來，他的父母見他是個俊美的孩子，就因着信，把他藏了三個月，並不怕王命。

en.text: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

zhSimplified.text: 摩西因着信，长大了就不肯称为法老女儿之子。

zhTraditional.text: 摩西因着信，長大了就不肯稱為法老女兒之子。

en.text: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

zhSimplified.text: 他宁可和 神的百姓同受苦害，也不愿暂时享受罪中之乐。

zhTraditional.text: 他寧可和上帝的百姓同受苦害，也不願暫時享受罪中之樂。

en.text: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

zhSimplified.text: 他看为基督受的凌辱比埃及的财物更宝贵，因他想望所要得的赏赐。

zhTraditional.text: 他看為基督受的凌辱比埃及的財物更寶貴，因他想望所要得的賞賜。

en.text: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

zhSimplified.text: 他因着信，就离开埃及，不怕王怒；因为他恒心忍耐，如同看见那不能看见的主。

zhTraditional.text: 他因着信，就離開埃及，不怕王怒；因為他恆心忍耐，如同看見那不能看見的主。

en.text: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

zhSimplified.text: 他因着信，就守逾越节，行洒血的礼，免得那灭长子的临近以色列人。

zhTraditional.text: 他因着信，就守逾越節，行灑血的禮，免得那滅長子的臨近以色列人。

en.text: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

zhSimplified.text: 他们因着信，过红海如行干地；埃及人试着要过去，就被吞灭了。

zhTraditional.text: 他們因着信，過紅海如行乾地；埃及人試着要過去，就被吞滅了。

en.text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人因着信，围绕耶利哥城七日，城墙就倒塌了。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人因着信，圍繞耶利哥城七日，城牆就倒塌了。

en.text: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

zhSimplified.text: 妓女喇合因着信，曾和和平平地接待探子，就不与那些不顺从的人一同灭亡。

zhTraditional.text: 妓女喇合因着信，曾和和平平地接待探子，就不與那些不順從的人一同滅亡。

en.text: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

zhSimplified.text: 我又何必再说呢？若要一一细说，基甸、巴拉、参孙、耶弗他、大卫、撒母耳，和众先知的事，时候就不够了。

zhTraditional.text: 我又何必再說呢？若要一一細說，基甸、巴拉、參孫、耶弗他、大衛、撒母耳，和眾先知的事，時候就不夠了。

en.text: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

zhSimplified.text: 他们因着信，制伏了敌国，行了公义，得了应许，堵了狮子的口，

zhTraditional.text: 他們因着信，制伏了敵國，行了公義，得了應許，堵了獅子的口，

en.text: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

zhSimplified.text: 灭了烈火的猛势，脱了刀剑的锋刃；软弱变为刚强，争战显出勇敢，打退外邦的全军。

zhTraditional.text: 滅了烈火的猛勢，脫了刀劍的鋒刃；軟弱變為剛強，爭戰顯出勇敢，打退外邦的全軍。

en.text: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

zhSimplified.text: 有妇人得自己的死人复活。又有人忍受严刑，不肯苟且得释放，为要得着更美的复活。

zhTraditional.text: 有婦人得自己的死人復活。又有人忍受嚴刑，不肯苟且得釋放，為要得着更美的復活。

en.text: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

zhSimplified.text: 又有人忍受戏弄、鞭打、捆锁、监禁、各等的磨炼，

zhTraditional.text: 又有人忍受戲弄、鞭打、捆鎖、監禁、各等的磨煉，

en.text: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

zhSimplified.text: 被石头打死，被锯锯死，受试探，被刀杀，披着绵羊山羊的皮各处奔跑，受穷乏、患难、苦害，

zhTraditional.text: 被石頭打死，被鋸鋸死，受試探，被刀殺，披着綿羊、山羊的皮各處奔跑，受窮乏、患難、苦害，

en.text: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 在旷野、山岭、山洞、地穴，飘流无定，本是世界不配有的人。

zhTraditional.text: 在曠野、山嶺、山洞、地穴，飄流無定，本是世界不配有的人。

en.text: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

zhSimplified.text: 这些人都是因信得了美好的证据，却仍未得着所应许的；

zhTraditional.text: 這些人都是因信得了美好的證據，卻仍未得着所應許的；

en.text: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

zhSimplified.text: 因为 神给我们预备了更美的事，叫他们若不与我们同得，就不能完全。

zhTraditional.text: 因為上帝給我們預備了更美的事，叫他們若不與我們同得，就不能完全。
